'''2011 Bespin Regionals Adam Schellberg DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Schellberg]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Adam Schettberg
* '''Deck name:''' invasion
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
